title: 雪融星溪

generationRuns.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. 生成一张1024x1536竖幅不透明塔罗闪卡完整绘画母版。参考图仅用于人物身份和精致古典幻想手绘画风，新主题须独立重构场景构图。雪融星溪：一位参考图同身份的棕色长发成年女子，穿蓝紫色古典长裙与细星冠，人物右中跪在雪缘石台，两手各持一壶。左壶连续水流落入左侧融雪池，右壶另一独立连续水流落入右下蜿蜒石溪，双落点清楚。一个主八芒星清楚悬于上方，远处雪峰与冷夜，幼花从雪缘生长。雪白、蓝紫、嫩绿，霜面星银窄框。雪缘石台、膝接地面和双落点完整连通。 保持自然肤色，双手双臂准确；必须只有一人、双壶双水流双落点，一个主八芒星，不可单流分叉充当双流。高细节绘画，清晰自然接触阴影，完整承接地面延伸到底边，窄边框不遮挡主体，满幅不透明画面。无文字、无字母数字、无标志水印，无拼图，无多余人物或手臂。

Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. ISOLATED DECORATION ONLY: 细小雪瓣. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main props, ALL buildings, ALL ground/floor/platforms, ALL borders and corner ornaments. Only a FEW small separate decorative elements at the original positions, preserving large empty center. If absent, create a sparse matching-style candidate. Every other pixel must be solid fully transparent pixels; no gradient or texture in key background. NO HUMAN, NO ANIMAL, NO SCENERY, NO FRAME. Do not turn the whole reference into a cutout of its subject. This is the small decorative overlay only. IMPORTANT: EXCLUDE the reference card edge stars, crescents, corner icons and any frame filigree. The requested light flecks/leaves are NEW independent small foreground particles, NOT edge furniture. Distribute 6 to 12 tiny separate elements at lateral sides, no central figure and no center emblem. Image 1 is the edit target. Override color-key wording: genuine transparent alpha background, only retained layer visible, preserve canvas coordinates; no baked green, magenta or checkerboard.
